item.question: Why are histograms and violin plots used in analyzing beam pattern residuals?
item.answer: Histograms and violin plots are used to statistically analyze the distribution of residuals between measured and modeled beam patterns. They help compare main beams and side lobes, highlighting differences between models like Gaussian and ZP.
